content: Dev Chatterjee called insurance agent Anjali Desai to discuss the renewal premium for his health policy HP-123456. He inquired about reducing the higher-than-expected premium caused by pre-existing conditions coverage. Anjali explained the increase and offered a payment plan, which Dev accepted. Dev requested confirmation that the policy would be updated and new documents sent.

action_items: Set up a payment plan for the health policy premium
Update the policy and send a new policy document to the customer
